v1.0.6 Update
- Fixed severe FPS drops on pages with large collections when participants adjusted shared Page Variables, such as counters. These changes could slow down other viewers even while they were idle.
- Collection displays avoid unnecessary refreshes, batch rapid variable updates, and apply pending changes when hidden sections or tabs are opened.
- While viewing a page, sections are built when first opened, reducing initial work on large pages. Returning to a section retains its reading position and selection.

announcement.title: 🎨 Landing Page Maker v1.0.6
announcement.content:
Landing Page Maker v1.0.6: Performance Hotfix

  • Fixed severe FPS drops on pages with large collections when participants adjusted shared Page Variables, such as counters. These changes could slow down other viewers even while they were idle.
  • Collection displays avoid unnecessary refreshes, batch rapid variable updates, and apply pending changes when hidden sections or tabs are opened.
  • While viewing a page, sections are built when first opened, reducing initial work on large pages. Returning to a section retains its reading position and selection.
